question: Should OpenClaw accept `heartbeat.fallbacks` as the public heartbeat-scoped fallback policy shape, including `[]` as strict fail-fast behavior?
rationale: This is an additive but durable operator-facing config contract, and root policy treats config/default additions and fallback behavior as compatibility-sensitive even when the code path is otherwise narrow.

options.title: Accept sibling heartbeat fallbacks
options.body: Proceed with `heartbeat.fallbacks` after fixing the docs formatting check, because it preserves unset behavior and reuses the existing per-run fallback override boundary.

options.title: Choose object-form heartbeat model
options.body: Pause this branch if maintainers prefer the older `{ primary, fallbacks }` shape for `heartbeat.model` instead of a sibling field.

options.title: Require live provider proof first
options.body: Hold merge until a maintainer or author captures a real exhausted-provider heartbeat fallback run in addition to unit coverage.

recommendation.title: Accept sibling heartbeat fallbacks
recommendation.body: Proceed with `heartbeat.fallbacks` after fixing the docs formatting check, because it preserves unset behavior and reuses the existing per-run fallback override boundary.
